item.title: Apple Keyboard has a blacklist of phrases you can't swipe
item.description:
📝 New research shows that Apple has a “grey list” of more than 100,000 words and phrases that it has restricted from being completed by its predictive text. Apple’s predictive text will not suggest these words. The list he found includes some unsurprising words and phrases.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/06/struggling-to-spell-male-chauvinist-pig-apple-grey-list-means-your-iphone-wont-help-you
